cristal-den/potiok-chaos.title: Chaos among the Potioks
cristal-den/potiok-chaos.description: The Changeling Queen wants the Potiok dynasty to tear itself apart, so the hive's affairs go unnoticed in Crystal Den.
cristal-den/potiok-chaos.sowChaosEither: Bring the Potiok dynasty down: either kill the Matriarch and let her heirs fight over the seat, or have the Matriarch name Trout Potiok (Petiole) her heir
cristal-den/potiok-chaos.desc-options: There are two ways to do this. The bloody one: kill the Matriarch and let the heirs tear each other apart. The quiet one: Petiole already wears Trout Potiok's face, so if the Matriarch names Trout her heir, the Potiok house is the hive's without a drop of blood.
cristal-den/potiok-chaos.installTrout: Get the Matriarch to name Trout Potiok her heir
cristal-den/potiok-chaos.desc-trout-plan: Petiole already wears Trout Potiok's face. Rather than spill blood, you will have the Matriarch name him heir.
cristal-den/potiok-chaos.desc-completed-chaos: The Matriarch is dead. Her heirs will tear each other apart over the succession, and Crystal Den will be busy with it for a long time.
cristal-den/potiok-chaos.desc-completed-heir: The Matriarch named Trout her heir. The Potioks have handed their house to the hive without suspecting it.
cristal-den/potiok-chaos.desc-failed: The plan fell apart, and the Potioks are on their guard.
